rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when something happens naturally or without being forced.

example.traditional: 大家自自然然咁一齊唱起歌嚟。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 zi6 zi6 jin4 jin4 gam3 jat1 cai4 coeng3 hei2 go1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when someone does something voluntarily and without being told or prompted.

example.english: They spontaneously tidied the room without anyone having to remind them.
example.traditional: 佢自動自覺咁幫手執好間房，完全唔使人提醒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 dung6 zi6 gok3 gam3 bong1 sau2 zap1 hou2 gaan1 fong4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sai2 jan4 tai4 sing2

rows.note: Use this for an action or response arising voluntarily from a person or group, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: Citizens spontaneously donated money to help families affected by the disaster.
example.traditional: 市民自發咁捐款幫助受災家庭。
example.jyutping: si5 man4 zi6 faat3 gam3 gyun1 fun2 bong1 zo6 sau6 zoi1 gaa1 ting4
